Entries use the selection-card schema in selection-card.schema.json. Stop rule (section 2) applies to this book on its own: max 20 bets, review at bet 10, terminates early if a decision changes because of this book's own running P/L — never because of another book's.
note: Six selections cleared Codex's own 3pp threshold in this single gameweek -- 30% of this book's entire 20-bet lifetime allocation in one week. Flagged in collaboration/debates/gw4-2026-09-13/reconciliation.md as more consistent with an uncalibrated model than a real, sustained edge. Recorded honestly per the fail-closed/frozen-rules discipline, not pruned -- but not silently treated as safe to act on either.
